Implementation Plan Planning ref: `orchestrator/project-8291` @ `c48063427d8dd3d613565d6adb952ec686da101b` (integration branch mismatch: false). Scope-mode: Hold Scope Reuse-audit: extends path_in_scope Scope-mode justification: The issue is the P7a half of P7 in the stuck-states project plan (step 2 under "P7 — Latch gaps" in `docs/plans/remove-unattended-pipeline-stuck-states-plan.md`). The harness auto-revalidate half is a separate issue, so `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` is not touched here. The change extends the matcher that already auto-allows lockfiles (`path_in_scope` in `scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py`) and adds no new script or call path. The fuller option costs fewer than 30 more lines. It adds validation of configured entries, hard-denies automation and `.git` prefixes in any letter case, and wires the repo variable into the three workflows that run the matcher in its default mode, so the documented kill switch actually works. It adds no dependency and no external interface, so it is chosen under §6 (Security > Correctness & safety > Backward compatibility > Operational clarity > Performance > Speed). ## Automation / scheduler wiring (§20.E) - **Script status:** this extends an existing helper, `scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py`. No new script, single-use script or supervisor is added. - **Entry points (all existing, no new trigger):** - The implement commit-time guard, scope-lock verifier and pre-push gate, all through `scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh` and `scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh` under `.github/workflows/implement.yml`, triggered by `/approved`. - The plan auto-approval `files_touched` check (`plan_files_outside_files_touched`), run by `.github/workflows/plan.yml` and by the poller's stall-recovery gate in `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` (cron). - **Long-running supervisor:** none needed. - **DB work:** none. - **`docs/scripts-pending-removal.md`:** no entry, because no script is added. ## Files likely to change - `scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py` - `tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py` - `.github/workflows/implement.yml` - `.github/workflows/plan.yml` - `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` - `README.md` - `changelog.d/stuck-states-p7a-scope-guard-auto-allow.md` (new) - `agents.d/stuck-states-p7a-scope-guard-auto-allow.md` (new) ## Functions or modules to implement All changes in `scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py`. Tabs, keep the existing style. None of these new names exist in the file today; check each again before adding it. 1. **Constants**, placed next to `LOCKFILE_BASENAMES`: - `SCOPE_GUARD_AUTO_ALLOW_DEFAULT = "changelog.d/*.md,tests/fixtures/**"` - `SCOPE_GUARD_AUTO_ALLOW_ENV = "SCOPE_GUARD_AUTO_ALLOW_PATHS"` - `SCOPE_GUARD_AUTO_ALLOW_OFF_VALUES = frozenset({"none", "off", "false", "0", "no"})` - `SCOPE_GUARD_AUTO_ALLOW_MAX_ENTRIES = 20` - `SCOPE_GUARD_AUTO_ALLOW_ENTRY_MAX_CHARS = 200` - `SCOPE_GUARD_AUTO_ALLOW_DENY_PREFIXES = AUTOMATION_PATH_PREFIXES + (".git",)` - A module-level set `_SCOPE_GUARD_AUTO_ALLOW_WARNED` so each ignored entry is logged once per process. 2. **`parse_scope_guard_auto_allow_paths(raw: str | None) -> tuple[list[str], list[tuple[str, str]]]`** (pure function). - **Default or disabled:** - `None`, or empty after `strip()`: use `SCOPE_GUARD_AUTO_ALLOW_DEFAULT`. GitHub Actions' `vars.X || 'default'` cannot pass an empty value, so empty must not mean "off". - A lower-cased value in `SCOPE_GUARD_AUTO_ALLOW_OFF_VALUES`: return `([], [])`. - **Parsing:** split on `,`, then run `normalize_path` and de-duplicate each entry (reuse `normalize_allowlist`). Keep at most `SCOPE_GUARD_AUTO_ALLOW_MAX_ENTRIES`; extras are ignored with reason `too_many`. - **Entries rejected, with their reason:** - `too_long`: the entry is longer than 200 characters. - `absolute`: the entry starts with `/`. - `parent_segment`: any segment is `..`, or a segment is empty. - `unanchored_glob`: the first segment contains `*`, `?` or `[`. This rejects `**`, `*.md` and `*/x`. - `automation_prefix`: the lower-cased first segment is in `SCOPE_GUARD_AUTO_ALLOW_DENY_PREFIXES`. - **Returns:** `(globs, ignored)`. 3. **`scope_guard_auto_allow_match(path: str) -> str | None`** - Reads `os.environ.get(SCOPE_GUARD_AUTO_ALLOW_ENV)` on every call (no caching, so tests that set the env work) and parses it. - For each new ignored entry, writes one line to stderr: `SCOPE_GUARD_AUTO_ALLOW_IGNORED entry= reason=`. - Hard-deny on the path: returns `None` when `is_automation_path(path)` is true (this function already lower-cases the first segment), when the first segment lower-cased is `.git`, or when any segment is `..`. - Otherwise returns the first glob where `entry_matches(glob, path)` is true, or `None`. - Log values go through the existing `_PLAN_LOG_UNSAFE_RE.sub("_", ...)` and are truncated to `PLAN_LOG_PATH_MAX_CHARS`. Both are module-level, so they resolve at call time. 4. **`path_in_scope` changes** (logic stays the same until the end): - Keep the order: lockfile, then own fragment, then allowlist entries. - Change the agents-fragment branch so it returns `True` only when covered and otherwise falls through. Today it returns the `any(...)` result directly. - Then, as the last check: `if allow_lockfiles and (glob := scope_guard_auto_allow_match(path)):` - write `SCOPE_GUARD_AUTO_ALLOWED path= glob=` to stderr - return `True`. - Otherwise return `False`. - Update the docstring and the module docstring's "Matching semantics" bullet list with one new bullet. - Gating on `allow_lockfiles` keeps every strict caller unchanged: `--strict-allowlist` on the heal route and in `review_conflict_prepare.sh`'s host-only check, and `run_heal_plan_scope_gate`'s `allow_lockfiles=False`. 5. No changes to `check_automation_paths`, `run_plan_auto_approval_gate`'s protected-path logic, exit codes, or stdout format. **Workflow wiring.** Add one row, `SCOPE_GUARD_AUTO_ALLOW_PATHS: ${{ vars.SCOPE_GUARD_AUTO_ALLOW_PATHS || 'changelog.d/*.md,tests/fixtures/**' }}`, in three places: - `implement.yml`: the top-level `env:`, directly after `ALLOW_OUT_OF_SCOPE_FILES` (around line 76), with a two-line comment. - `plan.yml`: the job env, after `PLAN_FILES_TOUCHED_GATE_ENABLED` (around line 103). - `orchestrate_poll.yml`: after each of the 5 `PLAN_FILES_TOUCHED_GATE_ENABLED: ${{` rows (around lines 938, 1348, 1568, 1666, 1694). YAML uses 2-space indentation. Run `wc -c` afterwards: `implement.yml` is 430,640 bytes today and grows by about 300, still under the 480,000 guard. ## Data structures affected - A new environment variable, `SCOPE_GUARD_AUTO_ALLOW_PATHS`: comma-separated globs. - Unset or empty means the default. - `none`, `off`, `false`, `0` or `no` disables it. - No JSON or DB schema changes. Grant records, plan-gate records and exit codes are unchanged. ## API or interface changes - **New behaviour in the default (non-strict) guard:** staged paths that match `changelog.d/*.md` (top level only) or `tests/fixtures/**` are in scope even when `files_touched` omits them. This applies to: - the issue-body list - the `ai:scope:` scope-lock allowlist, which already gets the lockfile allowance - the plan-time `plan_files_outside_files_touched` hold - the pre-push allow-list narrowing - **Strict modes are unchanged:** the heal route, the heal plan gate and the conflict host-only check. - **New stderr log prefixes:** - `SCOPE_GUARD_AUTO_ALLOWED path=

glob=` - `SCOPE_GUARD_AUTO_ALLOW_IGNORED entry= reason=` - Every caller either captures only stdout or sends stderr to `/dev/null` (checked: `plan.yml:3145`, `orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18764`, `implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:464`). None merges stderr into the parsed stdout. ## Decisions ### D1 — Hook point: last check in `path_in_scope`, gated by `allow_lockfiles` - Chosen: add the auto-allow as the final check in `path_in_scope`, only when `allow_lockfiles` is true. - Alternatives considered: a separate parameter threaded through `evaluate`, `evaluate_allowlist` and the CLI; checking before the allowlist. - Why: the project plan says "alongside lockfiles". Reusing the existing strict switch keeps the heal and conflict paths strict without touching any call site. Checking last means the log line appears only when the auto-allow actually decided the result. ### D2 — Empty means default; explicit tokens disable - Chosen: unset or empty uses the default. `none`, `off`, `false`, `0` or `no` turns the feature off. - Alternatives considered: treating empty as off. - Why: the workflow pattern `vars.X || 'default'` can never pass an empty value, and §8 requires a default inside the helper itself. An explicit token is the only kill switch that works through Actions. ### D3 — Hard-deny is a superset of the plan's list - Chosen: deny `.github`, `.claude`, `scripts`, `prompts`, `workflow-templates` and `.git`, case-insensitively, on both configured entries and paths. Also reject unanchored globs and `..`. - Alternatives considered: only the four prefixes the project plan names. - Why: `AUTOMATION_PATH_PREFIXES` already includes `prompts`, and the comment there says it must stay in sync with `_rb_fix_scope_is_protected`. Rejecting `**` and `*.md` stops a mistyped repo variable from turning the guard off. ### D4 — Wire the repo variable into three workflows - Chosen: add the env row to `implement.yml`, `plan.yml` and `orchestrate_poll.yml`. - Alternatives considered: rely on the helper default only (the project plan's P7 file list names no workflow files). - Why: the plan's rollout section lists `SCOPE_GUARD_AUTO_ALLOW_PATHS` as a repo variable, and rollback is "flip its switch".
